summary: The ansible-navigator doc subcommand settings are help-doc (--hd, ansible-doc help in stdout mode), plugin-name (positional) and plugin-type (-t: become, cache, callback, cliconf, connection, httpapi, inventory, lookup, module, netconf, shell, strategy or vars; default module).
questions: How do I view docs for a lookup plugin with ansible-navigator doc?
What plugin types does ansible-navigator doc support?
What is the default plugin type for ansible-navigator doc?
